issues.description: Silent no-op when delimiter is passed but param arrived as a list bypasses validation
issues.detail: Validation lives inside the isinstance(items, str) branch, so an invalid delimiter raises only when the param is a single string and silently passes when it arrived as multiple instances. Same call, different behavior depending on client encoding. Validate the delimiter unconditionally before the type check, then split conditionally.

issues.description: delimiter argument complects symbolic style names with literal split characters in an untyped str
issues.detail: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS maps both literals (',', '|', ' ') and symbolic names ('pipeDelimited', 'spaceDelimited') through one str arg, validated at runtime. A Literal[...] annotation would move the closed allowlist to the type system and eliminate the runtime ValueError path. Separate concepts; push validation to the edge.

issues.description: @overload stubs use `= None` instead of `= ...` for delimiter, breaking file convention
issues.detail: Every other kwarg in these overloads uses `= ...` as the placeholder (e.g. store: StoreArg = ..., default: ... = ...). Only the implementation owns the real default. Match the surrounding style across all delimiter overloads.

issues.description: keep_blank_qs_values interaction with delimiter splitting is documented but untested
issues.detail: Docstring claims keep_blank_qs_values has no effect on secondary splitting, but no test pins this for inputs like 'a,,b' or 'foo||bar'. Empty fragments after split are a classic off-by-one source. Add tests to lock the contract before the next maintainer has to guess.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates identity entries with alias entries
issues.detail: Mapping ',' to ',', '|' to '|', and ' ' to ' ' is notational noise. A frozenset of literal delimiters plus a small alias dict for the symbolic names would express intent more clearly and read better. Minor taste issue, not a blocker.

issues.description: No test exercises delimiter combined with a transform callable
issues.detail: get_param_as_list accepts a transform argument and the new code splits before transform is applied, but no parametrized test covers delimiter + transform together. Add one case to pin that transform runs uniformly on each split element. Small gap in an otherwise thorough matrix.

synthesis.summary: Small, focused patch adding a delimiter kwarg to get_param_as_list. The test matrix covers the main happy paths (comma/space/pipe, symbolic constants, percent-encoded pipe, auto_parse_qs_csv interaction). Two structural issues dominate: delimiter validation lives inside the isinstance(str) branch so behavior depends on client encoding, and the delimiter argument complects symbolic style names with literal split characters in an untyped str when a Literal annotation would push validation to the type system. Plus a style break (overloads use `= None` instead of `= ...`) and missing tests for the documented keep_blank_qs_values invariant. NEEDS-WORK, close to ACCEPT.
